Chapter 252: 0249 The Real Angel Investor

The menu offered a choice between Chinese and Western cuisine.

So did the service team.

As a group of men drinking together, they naturally chose Chinese food, which Shi Yuzhu had already ordered.

But the Chinese meal also had appetizers.

They came in small bowls, served one after another.

A female client manager, looking dignified and with a great figure, stood by in a blazer, providing butler-style service.

The private room's screen was removed, revealing the Pingtan performers who were already prepared.

There were two performers, a man and a woman. The man held a sanxian, the woman a pipa.

The female manager produced a handwritten list of songs. "Gentlemen, what would you like to hear?"

Chen Guiliang glanced at the song list. Seeing that no one else was speaking, he chose one he could understand. "The Pearl Pagoda."

Zhou Hongwei asked, "Xiao Chen, you've heard it before?"

"I know a little about the story," Chen Guiliang said.

Shi Yuzhu said, "Let's go with that."

The male performer asked, "Bosses, would you like us to tell the story from the beginning, or go straight to the singing parts?"

Shi Yuzhu was about to say go straight to the singing, but Chi Yufeng chimed in, "Tell the story from the beginning."

"Tell it then," Shi Yuzhu said.

President Chi Yufeng of Perfect World was a man of culture. He had been in education and publishing far longer than he had been in gaming.

To tell a story to bosses from all over the country, they naturally couldn't use the Suzhou dialect.

The male performer began telling the story in Mandarin, occasionally inserting some modern, trendy words.

The story was simple: the protagonist's family falls from grace, he goes to live with relatives, is looked down upon by his aunt, but his cousin gives him a precious treasure. After a series of hardships, the protagonist passes the imperial examinations with top honors and returns to show off and slap them in the face.

Chen Guiliang and Chi Yufeng listened with relish, while Shi Yuzhu and Zhou Hongyi huddled closer, smoking and chatting. Tao Chenggang might have had something come up at his company, as he got up and left the room to take a call.

Another appetizer was brought in. The female manager was about to introduce it when Chen Guiliang said, "That's not necessary."

The female manager retreated to her spot by the side.

The male performer condensed the story's background into a two-minute summary, then recited from the main act in the Suzhou dialect for another two minutes.

Finally, the singing began.

The sounds of the sanxian and pipa rang out, and the male performer began to sing, "She enters the garden in a hurried pace..."

Zhou Hongwei looked at Chen Guiliang and Chi Yufeng, and said in a low voice to Shi Yuzhu, "Do these two really enjoy listening to this?"

Shi Yuzhu said with a cigarette in his mouth, "They're men of culture. They're more particular about these things."

Zhou Hongwei smiled. "You, with a master's degree, don't count as a man of culture?"

"I'm what you call a man of science, a science graduate," Shi Yuzhu chuckled. "They're the ones in liberal arts, they count as men of culture."

Chi Yufeng suddenly turned his head. "I was in the chemistry department."

Shi Yuzhu roared with laughter. "I thought you were so engrossed in the Pingtan that you were oblivious to what we were saying."

Chen Guiliang said, "I'm a freeman. I finished my sophomore year without even choosing a major."

"How can you not choose a major? How do you take classes then?" Shi Yuzhu didn't understand the situation.

Chen Guiliang said, "I could sign up for any course in the university. Liberal arts, sciences, engineering, anything. Some people even took medical courses."

Shi Yuzhu was quite surprised. "For real?"

Chi Yufeng nodded. "Their class was pretty special."

Among the four of them, Chen Guiliang was from Peking University, Chi Yufeng from Tsinghua, Zhou Hongwei from Xi'an Jiaotong University, and Shi Yuzhu from Zhejiang University.

Oh, and there was Tao Chenggang, who went to some junior college.

Tao Chenggang returned after his call, smiling. "Everyone's chatting now?"

They were indeed chatting. The Pingtan performance had faded into background music.

Mainly because they couldn't understand the dialect.

After several appetizers, the main courses finally began to arrive.

The Maotai was poured to the brim.

Chen Guiliang wasn't quite used to the sauce-aroma type; he preferred the strong-aroma type from Sichuan.

The female manager had been dismissed. With a few big guys drinking, her presence to introduce the dishes was a bit of a hindrance.

The two Pingtan performers continued to sing, but no one was listening anymore.

Shi Yuzhu pointed at Tao Chenggang and said to the others, "Did you guys know this kid used to run a private server for Legend of Mir? I even played on his server, spent tens of thousands on it."

Zhou Hongyi chuckled. "That's what you call aiding the enemy. President Tao's development of 'Quan Yu Tian Xia' was funded in part by those tens of thousands you provided."

"Who the hell knew he would go on to make a legitimate game? And the content is so similar to my 'Zhengtu,' and it fucking launched even earlier than mine!" Shi Yuzhu was so frustrated he started swearing repeatedly.

Tao Chenggang laughed heartily. "Thank you for your support, President Shi. Come, let me toast you, President Shi."

"Bottoms up!"

Shi Yuzhu drained his glass and slapped his thigh. "Damn it. I thought he was doing a good job with the private server and even wanted to poach him for a high salary to be a planner for 'Zhengtu.' The kid turned me down!"

Chi Yufeng was rather curious. "So, you two knew each other from way back?"

Tao Chenggang said, "I chatted with President Shi on QQ."

"Had you already decided to make a free-to-play game back then?" Shi Yuzhu finally asked the question that had been bugging him for over half a year.

Inviting Tao Chenggang for drinks today was mainly to ask this very question!

He'd been stewing on it for too long.

But Tao Chenggang didn't answer directly. "Haha, you guess."

Shi Yuzhu urged, "Spit it out, spit it out."

Chen Guiliang spoke up. "President Shi, is that the attitude for someone seeking answers? Drink three glasses first!"

Chen Guiliang wouldn't have said this to anyone else, but telling Shi Yuzhu to drink was perfectly normal.

Sure enough, Shi Yuzhu chugged three glasses. "Now talk!"

Tao Chenggang said, "I ran the Legend of Mir private server to earn more money to develop 'Quan Yu Tian Xia.'"

"Fuck! So I really was aiding the enemy."

The answer only made Shi Yuzhu more pissed off.

"Hahahaha!"

The others took pleasure in his misfortune, bursting into collective laughter.

"President Shi, I've chatted with you on QQ too." Chen Guiliang wasn't afraid of them leaking secrets. In any case, he would just firmly deny anything that came out of these guys' mouths in the future.

Shi Yuzhu frowned. "When did we ever chat?"

Chen Guiliang smiled. "You thought you were chatting with President Tao on QQ, but sometimes it was me doing the typing."

The other three instantly fell silent, all staring at Chen Guiliang in astonishment.

Zhou Hongwei asked, "You two knew each other before starting the company?"

Tao Chenggang clinked glasses with Zhou Hongwei. "I was running an internet cafe at the time. A high school classmate of mine came to me with his nephew. His nephew was still a high school senior, and he came up with a game concept, telling me, 'President Tao, I'll sell this to you for 300,000 yuan.'"

Shi Yuzhu exclaimed in shock, "The design document for 'Quan Yu Tian Xia'?"

"Yes and no. The kid held something back, he didn't give me everything," Tao Chenggang said. "In the end, I only gave him a few tens of thousands. He never asked for the subsequent payments. The instance-dungeon-style private server for Legend was also his idea. We partnered up on that."

Chi Yufeng clinked glasses with Chen Guiliang. "Such skills as a high school senior. President Chen, you're amazing!"

Hearing this made Shi Yuzhu even more depressed. "You should have come to me! Forget 300,000, I would have given you 3 million."

"You were too far away, and I didn't know you," Chen Guiliang said. "I'll toast President Shi. The startup capital for the two companies I founded also includes a contribution from President Shi. President Shi is a kind angel, our angel investor."

"Hahaha!"

Zhou Hongwei seemed to have a low threshold for humor; he was so amused he burst out laughing and slapped his thigh hard.

Chi Yufeng commented, "It really was angel investing. He didn't even ask for equity. Too angelic."

Shi Yuzhu was both exasperated and amused. He clinked glasses with Chen Guiliang and said sincerely, "You two are truly impressive. I've made a friend in you. Let's drink!"

Having a drink with him meant you were a friend. Shi Yuzhu himself probably had no idea how many friends he had.

It's unclear if you can judge a person's character at the dinner table, but their personality certainly comes through.

After drinking, Chen Guiliang was in the same camp as Chi Yufeng. Although he started talking more, he could still maintain a relative degree of restraint.

Shi Yuzhu, Zhou Hongwei, and Tao Chenggang were in another camp. After they got drunk, they dared to say all sorts of outrageous things, even slamming the table and cursing from time to time.

"Those foreigners at Yahoo headquarters are all idiots!"

Zhou Hongwei slurred, "They made me president of Yahoo China, but they fucking want me to report everything. I'm just not gonna report it, I'm gonna overstep my authority and break their rules. Every time I do something behind the foreigners' backs, it turns out to be a success. Haha, those foreign devils can only turn a blind eye."

Tao Chenggang raised his glass. "President Zhou is awesome. Here's to you, bottoms up!"

Zhou Hongwei said, "President Tao is awesome too, starting from scratch. Come, let's have three in a row!"

"Drink!"

Zhou Hongwei downed three glasses and continued to brag, "My decision to make 360 Safeguard was well-considered. There are too many rogue software programs out there right now, and users are in dire need of software that can uninstall them. I'm going to wipe out all the rogue software in China within three years!"

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: And then you'll become the biggest rogue of them all.

Actually, what left a deeper impression on Chen Guiliang was Zhou Hongyi's famous livestreaming moment.

Zhou Hongyi had invested in Neta Auto himself, but during a factory inspection, he pointed at the Neta management and yelled, "You don't understand anything, can't you learn from Lei Jun... Your car's infotainment system is so laggy... You call putting a fridge in the back seat user experience? The steering wheel looks like a design from a gasoline car ten years ago..."

This was a fucking livestream!

Was he trying to make Neta Auto die faster?

Only the infamous scene at the Nio car launch event could top the outrageous antics of the 'Red-Clothed Hierarch'.

The Nio founder's wife served as the host at the Nio launch event and managed to offend two investors, Yu Minhong and Zhang Zetian, in one go. To salvage the situation, this woman then proceeded to offend a third investor, Lei Jun, from afar.

As long as I offend all my investors, it's as if I've offended no one!

Her main goal was to distribute the offense equally.

The three of them drank more and more, and were already slinging their arms around each other's shoulders and talking nonsense.

Chi Yufeng was still sober. He handed Chen Guiliang a cigarette. "President Chen, you can really hold your liquor."

"My tolerance is decent."

Chen Guiliang walked over to the two Pingtan performers and said, "You two can leave now. Thank you for your hard work."

The two performers bowed and left.

Chen Guiliang wasn't sure if he should give them a tip—well, the traditional term would be a 'reward'.

Whatever, Shi Yuzhu was paying anyway.

Chen Guiliang came back and pulled a stool next to Chi Yufeng. "President Chi's company is big, with rich experience in game development. Our companies are close to each other. I was wondering if I could send some of my developers to Perfect World for a visit to learn a thing or two?"

"No problem. Come as soon as you can. I'll be waiting," Chi Yufeng said.

Chen Guiliang said, "Thank you so much."

Chi Yufeng asked, "I hear Game Science is also developing its own engine?"

Chen Guiliang nodded. "It's different from Perfect's engine. We're focusing on 2D fighting."

"Fighting?" Chi Yufeng's interest was piqued.

Chen Guiliang said, "Just like traditional arcade fighting games, where players can fight against each other. There are no commercial engines like this on the market; they're all privately held by other companies, so I can only develop my own."

Chi Yufeng said, "Then we should communicate more. Are you planning to make 'My Own Swordsman' in 3D?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Q-version 2D."

Chi Yufeng praised, "You can make money just with the name 'My Own Swordsman' alone."

"Same with your company's 'Zhu Xian.' That novel is incredibly popular. It's about to enter closed beta, right?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Chi Yufeng said, "Closed beta next month."

As the two were chatting, Shi Yuzhu, with his arms around Zhou Hongwei and Tao Chenggang's shoulders, suddenly shouted, "Let's go, let's go, time for karaoke. We'll sing and keep drinking!"

Zhou Hongwei boasted, "I'm not bragging, but I'm an expert at singing."

"I was in a singing competition when I was a kid!" Tao Chenggang roared.

Chen Guiliang called Yang Shuo. "Have their assistants come in. These guys are all drunk."

They moved to a new location to continue drinking.

This time, there would probably be girls to drink with.

Chen Guiliang was a pure man, a man who had transcended vulgar interests. Of course, he wasn't going for the singing with girls, but to continue discussing business with Chi Yufeng.

(End of this chapter)
